applies_why: The judge text treats Matthew 1:20 as UNDERDETERMINED because the one verse has competing readings, which is the one-verse situation K-S2 governs.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. This is about one verse. It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains.
room: the phrase 'does not apply when the judge weighs two chains' and two readings: (a) the text is resolving a one-verse clash over Matthew 1:20, so K-S2 applies; (b) the text is weighing the DR3 and CR2/CR3 chains as wholes, so the exception applies.
why: The judge marks Matthew 1:20 UNDERDETERMINED because each side reads the one verse differently, which K-S2 forbids by making both senses stand rather than treating the verse as open.
